Method of Attack: Critical authentication bypass allowing unauthenticated access to restricted REST API endpoints
Persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability enabling injection of malicious code and manipulation of chat sessions
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using WP Live Chat Support plugin
Attack Vector: Exploitation of REST API endpoints via wplc_api_permission_check() function flaw
Injection of malicious JavaScript via XSS vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Injection and editing of chat messages
Denial of service by ending active chat sessions
Malicious JavaScript causing redirection, pop-ups, and fake subscriptions
